title: Mori C NDE 847
content: On the operating table, I came out of my body. I went for a walk and I saw a whirlwind of white light. Then, I am between a border separating the world here from the celestial or astral. I entered in a light that illuminated this experience. It was brilliant and beautiful all along a white passageway. I saw a Jesus, very beautiful and serene. He told me that it is too early for me to be here and showed me my child wrapped in gold. He showed me my husband who was very sad in the room of hospital. I chose to return to help people. (I wrote a book that is due to be published shortly, to help people in the despair.) At this moment, I was projected in my body with great speed.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes hemorrhage from ectopic pregnancy; grossese ectopique avec hémoragie interne Life threatening event, but not clinical death Severe blood loss; perte de sang importante
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.At what time during the experience were: Extremely good, better than when I’m awake... very vivid and real
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Just the noise of quiet, soft bells
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I believe to have met Jesus. He spoke to me and helped me to return. He told me that my time was not finished and that I had to help people. I could also see my dead child.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I felt the most wonderful feelings, so clear
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Yes, sense of well-being and love
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No I felt an imposition but I didn't want to come back not at all here because it was so good to be there... but it was necessary to come back…
elements.What is your religion now?: Liberal I am closer to nature: plus croyante et plus pres de la nature
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes More in the joy of the present moment. I believe in god. I pray and am thankful to be here because God saved me. I believe in values of life, of love, of compassion.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes not of this world .. another level
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Clairvoyance. I have some dreams premonitions. I received the words that guided me in life (someone speaks to me). I am now more intuitive. My life is special.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best: peace and serenity. Worse: to come back in this body so sick.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes It is difficult because it just happened.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: A beautiful experience in my life one of the richest.
